reason: I only get my nails done when there's a wedding, debut or holiday coming, and I don't have one this month. Even then, ₱1,800 from a new page I've never heard of is more than I pay at the mall for gel art, so I'd probably just stick with my usual salon.
objection: Will gel done at home really last as long as salon gel? It's a brand-new business with no reviews I can see, and I'm not sure the lamp and the artist are as good as what the mall uses.
would_change_my_mind: Having an event coming up, plus real customer photos showing the nails still intact after 2 to 3 weeks, or friends in Cainta who've used them.
